# LISTING PROGRAM

## Struktur Modul

Paket `HeatPipeCore` terdiri atas enam modul yang di-*include* oleh modul
utama:

```julia
module HeatPipeCore

include("FluidProperties.jl")
include("Wick.jl")
include("Limits.jl")
include("ThermalNetwork.jl")
include("Validation.jl")
include("ISRDesign.jl")

using .FluidProperties
using .Wick
using .Limits
using .ThermalNetwork
using .Validation
using .ISRDesign

end # module
```

## Limit Operasional (kutipan `Limits.jl`)

```julia
function q_viscous(hp::HeatPipe, T::Real)
    f = hp.fluid
    p = p_sat(f, T)
    h = h_fg(f, T)
    rv = hp.r_v
    return pi * rv^4 * h * rho_v(f, T) * p /
           (16.0 * mu_v(f, T) * effective_length(hp))
end

function q_sonic(hp::HeatPipe, T::Real)
    f = hp.fluid
    Rg = R_specific(f)
    a = sqrt(f.gamma * Rg * T / (2.0 * (f.gamma + 1.0)))
    return vapour_area(hp) * rho_v(f, T) * h_fg(f, T) * a
end

function q_entrainment(hp::HeatPipe, T::Real)
    f = hp.fluid
    r_hw = hp.wick.r_eff
    return vapour_area(hp) * h_fg(f, T) *
           sqrt(sigma(f, T) * rho_v(f, T) / (2.0 * r_hw))
end
```

## Neraca Tekanan Kapiler

```julia
function q_capillary(hp::HeatPipe, T::Real; include_gravity::Bool = true)
    f = hp.fluid
    dp_c = 2.0 * sigma(f, T) / hp.wick.r_eff

    dp_g = 0.0
    if include_gravity
        dp_g = rho_l(f, T) * hp.g * total_length(hp) * sin(hp.orientation)
    end
    dp_avail = dp_c - dp_g
    dp_avail <= 0.0 && return 0.0

    h = h_fg(f, T)
    cl = mu_l(f, T) * effective_length(hp) /
         (rho_l(f, T) * hp.wick.K * wick_area(hp) * h)
    cv = 8.0 * mu_v(f, T) * effective_length(hp) /
         (pi * rho_v(f, T) * hp.r_v^4 * h)

    return dp_avail / (cl + cv)
end
```

## Penyelesaian Tunak (`ThermalNetwork.jl`)

```julia
function steady_state(hp::HeatPipe, Q::Real; n::Int = 60,
                      dT_sink::Real = 8.0, tol::Real = 1e-6,
                      maxiter::Int = 200)
    net = build_network(hp; n = n, Q = Q, dT_sink = dT_sink)

    function residual(Tv)
        G = conductances(net, Tv)
        Tw = solve_wall(net, G, Tv, net.G_sink)
        return sum(G .* (Tw .- Tv))
    end

    lo = hp.fluid.T_melt + 1.0
    hi = min(0.98 * hp.fluid.T_crit, 2500.0)
    flo = residual(lo)
    fhi = residual(hi)

    T_v = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
    for _ in 1:maxiter
        T_v = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        fr = residual(T_v)
        if abs(fr) < 1e-6 || (hi - lo) < tol
            break
        end
        if sign(fr) == sign(flo)
            lo = T_v
            flo = fr
        else
            hi = T_v
        end
    end

    G_rad = conductances(net, T_v)
    T_wall = solve_wall(net, G_rad, T_v, net.G_sink)
    return (T_v = T_v, T_wall = T_wall, z = net.z,
            dT_ec = maximum(T_wall[net.region .== :evaporator]) -
                    minimum(T_wall[net.region .== :condenser]),
            R_eq = (T_v - hp.T_sink) / Q)
end
```

## Contoh Penggunaan

```julia
using HeatPipeCore

# Validasi KRUSTY
v = krusty_validation()
println(v.max_err, " ", v.pass)
println(nominal_point_validation())

# Kelayakan ISR pada 1200 K
for r in isr_feasibility(T = 1200.0)
    println(r.fluid, " ", r.wick, " ", r.Q_max)
end

# Diameter yang diperlukan untuk 8,2 kW
println(isr_required_diameter(Na; T = 1200.0, wick = :arterial))

# Opsi arsitektur dan neraca massa
o = isr_options()
println(o.A, o.B, o.C)
println(isr_mass_balance())
```
